Assignment: Literature Review on Fairness in Machine Learning
CIS 6930
Instructions: Write a literature review of 1,500-2,000 words examining fairness metrics in classification.
Use at least five peer-reviewed scholarly sources published since 2018.
Format your paper and citations in APA 7th edition.
Submit a .docx file through Canvas. Include a title page and reference page.
This assignment is worth 100 points.
